HEADER
Wissem Kadri
+216 55 052 204  |  wissem.kadri@proton.me  |  github.com/wissemkadri  |  linkedin.com/in/wissemkadri
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Summary
TECHNICAL SKILLS
DevOps Engineer with experience building and automating cloud-native infrastructure on AWS using Kubernetes, Terraform, and  GitOps  practices.  Focused  on  improving  deployment  reliability,  security,  and  delivery  speed  through  CI/CD  and infrastructure automation. First CNCF Golden Kubestronaut from Tunisia.
DevOps Engineer
United VITO
Migrated production workloads from bare-metal to AWS Kubernetes, adopting a modern GitOps-based CI/CD workflow
Designed and implemented GitOps CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD, reducing deployment errors and accelerating release cycles
Automated cloud infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management using Terraform
Integrated Trivy container image scanning into CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated detection of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in Docker images before deployment
Configured and operated Kubernetes clusters, improving application reliability and scalability
Technologies: AWS (EKS, ECR, ALB, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM), GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Trivy, Sealed Secrets, Helm, Cloudflare
DevSecOps Engineer Intern
Hendrik Thurau Enterprises
Project: Implementation of an Automated DevSecOps Pipeline for Application Deployment with Kubernetes and GitOps
Built an end-to-end DevSecOps pipeline enabling consistent, repeatable releases and reducing manual deployments
Maintained a lightweight Kubernetes environment, improving deployment efficiency and reducing infrastructure overhead
Integrated security scanning across the CI pipeline (SAST, secrets detection, container scanning), identifying vulnerabilities early and strengthening application security before deployment
Automated artifact management and traceability, ensuring reproducible builds and easier rollback in case of failures
Implemented a GitOps deployment workflow, enabling faster, reliable, version-controlled releases
Strengthened secrets management, reducing exposure of sensitive data and improving overall system security
Introduced pre-production validation (DAST), improving release confidence and reducing risk of production issues
Built a centralized observability stack, enabling real-time monitoring and faster incident detection and resolution
Secured internal services with identity-based access controls, strengthening protection of critical infrastructure
Technologies: Linux, Kubernetes, K3s, Helm, cert-manager, ArgoCD, Sealed Secrets, Harbor, Jenkins, Docker, Hadolint, Gitleaks, Trivy, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, MinIO, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Fluentd, Kibana, Cloudflare
Web Server Administrator
United VITO
Managed and maintained a multi-tenant web hosting environment using HestiaCP, handling web server configuration, database provisioning, domain management, and SSL automation
Deployed and operated 30+ production web applications, ensuring high availability and stable client hosting
Integrated secure payment processing (Konnect gateway) into client applications, enabling reliable online transactions
Implemented an automated offsite backup strategy to Amazon S3, improving disaster recovery and data durability
Developed backend services for automated Facebook Catalog product synchronization
Technologies: AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC), Linux, HestiaCP, Laravel, MariaDB, Cloudflare, OVH
Full Stack Developer Intern
Hendrik Thurau Enterprises
Developed a Marketplace module enabling users to create and manage listings, participate in auctions, manage favorites, purchase items, and submit reviews, extending an existing platform's functionality
Implemented real-time auction and bidding features using Socket.IO, improving interactivity and ensuring live updates
Integrated backend APIs using Express.js to support marketplace workflows such as listings, bids, and order status updates
Built and enhanced a mobile-responsive frontend interface using Ionic and Angular, improving usability across devices
